description.default: The DocuSign template ID the acceptance flow builds each envelope from (TAD section 5.8, wbs:3.2). A template lives inside one DocuSign account, so this is a deployment value and cannot come from source (C-TECH-047) - a different DocuSign account in a later environment needs its own template and its own value here.

hint.default: DocuSign > Templates > the acceptance letter template > Template ID. For DEV this is the template the reviewer built directly in DocuSign from the acceptance letter forms (b832b15e-489d-4b13-a78b-0abef700803a) - set as this environment's CURRENT VALUE, never as a default here (IMP-0121). Required: the acceptance flow cannot build an envelope without it.
